meaning:
θάλπω
[in LXX for סָכַן, etc. ;]
to heat, warm; metaphorically,
(a) to inflame (Trag.);
(b) to foster, cherish: Eph.5:29, 1Th.2:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;
But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
